scenes.heading: Down, down-up, up-down-up
lines: Let's practice the folk pattern: Down, Down-Up, Up-Down-Up.
On beat 3, your hand moves down but misses the strings, then catches the up-strum.
Keep your wrist loose and let the motion flow naturally — it's all about timing and touch.
Strum down, then down-up, up, and down-up.
With the metronome at 60, each beat is a full strum.
Keep your wrist loose and let the pattern flow.
Strum down, then down-up, up, and down-up.
Keep time with the metronome at 70 bpm.
The folk pattern is Down, Down-Up, Up-Down-Up.
Let's play it — the app will listen through the microphone.
